In today's video I complete the Mimpi goes to Mars level in Mimpi Dreams!!
► Merch → http://ethangamer.store
► Ethan Gamer Land → http://ethangamer.land
► Subscribe → http://subscribe.ethangamer.com

• Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/ethangamer/

Story

The bad guy is using a volcano as a cannon to shoot down the stars!! What would be a night sky without them shining away? Mimpi embarks on a journey into the heart of the volcano to save the stars and find a way to get them home.

Puzzles

Mars features a record portion of challenges. Mimpi will again need your skills to overcome them. But it won't be easy. There are no hint balloons.

Features

larger than the rest of the game, it's almost like Mimpi Dreams 2
enhanced gameplay, new puzzles
new story, new animated characters
thousands of graphical assets
hundreds of new sounds

About Mimpi

Mimpi is a lazy doggy who likes to sleep a lot. In his dreams, he becomes the dog hero, who rescues and saves whoever is in need of rescuing or saving! Be it a lost pirate ship, a lab rat who wants to be free or a princess held by a dragon - Mimpi hero is here to save the day. Of course, Mimpi cannot do it without his sidekick and that is YOU!

Mimpi and you are the makers of his dreams. Help Mimpi be the hero by manipulating his dreams - move obstacles to allow Mimpi to get through levels, solve puzzles and help Mimpi communicate with the creatures in his dreams.

About ROBLOX

ROBLOX is not just an online game; it is an online virtual playground and workshop. ROBLOX was created in 2006 and is aimed at children of all ages. Almost every game on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. 

Roblox was founded by David Baszucki and Erik Cassel in 2004 when it was known as Dynablocks. It was renamed to ROBLOX in 2005, and the game was released to the general public in 2006.

ROBLOX has it's own currency called Robux. In early 2006 it was called ROBLOX Points.

Play Roblox
▶︎ https://www.roblox.com

There are so many different awesome games to play in ROBLOX. I love the Escape games like Escape McDonalds and Escape the Evil Farm. I also love the Roblox adventure games like Super Paper Roblox. Roleplay games like Beach House Roleplay are really fun too as well as Roblox mini game types like Ripull Minigames and Roblox Deathrun. 

What are your favourite Roblox games? Be sure to tell me in the comments and I will try and play them and maybe even make a video on it!

CBz4rqi2KAI.description:
In today's video I play ANIMAL SUPER SQUAD!
► Merch → http://ethangamer.store
► Ethan Gamer Land → http://ethangamer.land
► Subscribe → http://subscribe.ethangamer.com

• Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/ethangamer/

Animal Super Squad is a new and creative game where a big part of the gameplay is created and shared by the community. Players can create their own maps, upvote the best maps, and once a week, have a chance at being featured in the Weekly Spotlight. All gameplay assets used by the developers of the game are available for the players to use in the level editor, consisting of hundreds of assets and easy-to-use scripts. However, if you just want to play other people’s maps instead of creating your own, that’s perfectly fine too, we won’t judge you, everyone’s welcome here buddy.

Naturally, you can play the developer-made Adventure Mode as well, which feature a smooth learning curve in the beginning, and frustratingly impossible levels in the end.

#ethangamer

In today's Minecraft video I jump back into the Ethan Gamer Fans Minecraft World 2.0!
► Merch → http://ethangamer.store
► Ethan Gamer Land → http://ethangamer.land

• Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/ethangamer/

If you want a chance to play with me and be in future episodes you need the new Xbox or Windows 10 PC version of Minecraft plus an Xbox Live account so you can add me as a friend. I'm not 100% sure but I think Nintendo Switch works too.

My gamertag is ETH4N6AMER

If you've sent me a friend request and I haven't accepted it yet please be patient while I get through the requests. 

Please don't add me as a friend if you no longer play Minecraft because I'm only using this account to play Minecraft with fans and record new episodes of Ethan Gamer Fans Minecraft World 2.0.

If you see me online playing Minecraft try and join my game. It will usually be Sunday afternoon when I play. I will usually post a message on my Xbox Live account before I start the game. 

I'll leave the server open for anyone on my friends list to join. Don't wait for an invite just join when you see that I am playing.

There is a maximum of 7 players allowed in a server so it will be hard to get in because lots of other players will be trying as well.  Please don't spam me with messages if you can't get in. There's nothing I can do and sometimes it's just lucky.

I'm hoping to make lots of episodes so there will be lots of chances to join.

RULES

- no griefing
- be respectful to the other players
- work together as a team and help each other
- no cursing

If you break the rules you might get banned.
